description:
The Vilano R2 Commuter Aluminum Road Bike Shimano 21 Speed 700c is a simple road bike, perfect for the cost-conscious beginning cyclist’s ride to work, or a quick trip around town or campus.

This is an ideal entry-level road bike at an amazingly low price. Our satisfaction guarantee comes with every Vilano R2 Commuter Aluminum Road Bike purchased.

This bicycle is easy on the pocket and easy on the road! Free pedals are included with this basic road bike.

The novice cyclist, strapped for cash college student, or a person looking to get into biking again are all sure to enjoy the basic road bike with many plus qualities.

components.description: A lightweight 6061 aluminum frame, urban commuter saddle, and 700c double-walled alloy wheels are all part of the simple look of this affordable road bike.
This no-nonsense road bike has 21 speeds facilitated by the Shimano A050 thumb rear indexed 7-speed and front friction 3-speed shifters.
The Aluminum Road Bike has mount points on the frame for a water bottle, making it an excellent commuter bike.
